title: wholesome crunchy croatian fish bowl
description: a cultured, pescatarian-friendly dish featuring poached fish, crunchy slaw, and a hint of vanilla.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Place the fish on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the slaw by combining the grated carrots, shredded cabbage, and sliced onion in a bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and apple cider vinegar.
Pour the dressing over the slaw and toss to combine.
Once the fish is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the slaw in the bottom, followed by a piece of fish.
Place a vanilla pod on top of the fish, then drizzle with additional lemon juice if desired.
